text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! We can still go much further!
We're nowhere near done yet!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll go toward a new frontier!
Time to set sail for the Seven Seas!"

text_block_list.name: 4 Companions
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

Even after her first three years in the Twinkle Series,
Tap Dance City continued to run wild.

Not just at home, but across the globe.
And always by her side was—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, everyone, commemorative photo time!
Give me your best smiles!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Say cheese! Cheeeese!
I had dear friends whom I loved.

Many Umamusume compete with the backing
of prestigious families or influential figures. Amidst that—

Running around like a one-woman rogue brigade,
Tap Dance City stood out brilliantly.
And then—
(Crunch, crunch, crunch)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yo, long time no see.
It's been a while since we talked like this.
Yeah. We're both pretty busy.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I'm having a lot more fun with it
than I used to.

This Umamusume is Gold City.
She also works as a model and is a
once-in-a-century beauty.

From what I hear, the story of how they met
Tap Dance City goes...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're a City too?
What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
She's an incredible beauty.
But more than that—look at those eyes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eyes...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Deep down in your heart, you've got something you can't compromise on, right?
Am I right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You... seem kinda rough around the edges,
but you actually notice quite a lot, huh?

Apparently, they hit it off pretty well
ever since then.

Because Gold City has such striking looks,
rumor has it that her actual running rarely gets the spotlight it deserves, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tap. I made one too, you know.
A fan club for people who support my running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"And from there, the number of people who genuinely
wanted to support me as an athlete increased quite a bit."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's great.
After all, when push comes to shove, the one you can rely on is—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's not about looks; it's about heart.
Because we're comrades connected soul to soul.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Club members
are a bit different, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She understands how I feel about racing, empathizes with me, and gives me her honest thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, it's actually been the other way around,
and I've been the one listening to their troubles."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you have worries, do you?
Turns out you're pretty open-minded after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Never pegged 'em as the type
to look after others, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I thought so myself.
However...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've changed.
The new place called the club changed me...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "It's nice, isn't it? Having a place where you can just be yourself."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if the environment around us
will slowly change like this too."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah—the sea, you see.
It has to be equal to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd accept that only the rich get to go on adventures.
Opportunities gotta be equal for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep growing the numbers from here on out!
All the folks supporting us from the grassroots!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
As long as you've got comrades, you can do anything!
Right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I think so too.
Tap Dance City gathered allies with her natural charisma, charting a new course through the power of her companions.
Yearning to emulate those great achievements...

Hey, you're a Trainer, right?
Could it be that...!

Wonder if even I'd have a shot...?
If I had teammates or something.

Once again, a new Umamusume opens the door
to the races, gathering small fragments of hope.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
it's the start of a new era.
A brand-new era starts now!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Status and wealth don't matter.
Even if you start out completely alone...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: As long as you round up a big bunch of allies, you can handle anything in this day and age! Right?

Tap Dance City showed everyone a shining success story.
Rising from obscurity, gathering countless small supports, and then—

She has conquered numerous major races.
Though she is now a target for Umamusume all around the world—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, bring it on! No matter who the opponent is.
Our running won't lose to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The two-as-one running style that you and I polished to perfection.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you a new dream!
I'm gonna show the pre-debut
Umamusume an enormous dream!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Every youth eventually embarks on a journey.
Out toward unseen seas, alongside trusted companions!"
Tap Dance City, who flatly refuses to flatter power and always walks her own path. Just like her—
The number of Umamusume running with the support of their devoted peers now reaches tens of thousands. And—
Within that circle of companions, there was always an extraordinary sense of unity and smiles.

"To live not merely as fans, but as comrades."
This, too, is a piece of the culture
that continues to enrich the world of Umamusume.
